steps.caption: Google Reviews
steps.narration: This is Google Reviews. It asks every client for a Google review after the job, and keeps the answers in one place.

steps.caption: Sent, opened, rated, waiting
steps.narration: The top row counts what you've sent, how many opened the Google link, the positive feedback, and who hasn't answered yet.

steps.caption: Each request and where it stands
steps.narration: Below it, each request shows the client, the job, and where it stands: scheduled, pending, or Google link opened, with their private rating.

steps.caption: Send a request
steps.narration: To ask someone, choose New review request.

steps.caption: Name, email, a note, photos, send or schedule
steps.narration: Enter the client's name and email, add a personal note or job photos, and send it now or schedule it for later.

steps.caption: Back to the list
steps.narration: Reminders follow on your schedule until the client answers.

steps.caption: What your client sees
steps.narration: Your client gets a short page. They rate the job privately, from one to ten.

steps.caption: A private rating
steps.narration: Whatever the score, the Google review option is right there at the top. No gating, no rewards.

steps.caption: Your profile's reviews
steps.narration: Back on your side, reviews from your linked Google listing sync in under Google profile reviews.

steps.caption: Synced reviews with AI reply drafts
steps.narration: Each one comes with an AI reply draft in your tone. You approve it, edit it, or let the plans that include it publish automatically.

steps.caption: Menu: Google Reviews
steps.narration: You'll find Google Reviews in the menu on the left, under Growth.

youtube.title: Google Reviews in about a minute | ConstructHUB
youtube.description: A one-minute tour of Google Reviews in ConstructHUB: send review requests after each job, see what each client did, show every client the Google review option, and reply to synced Google reviews with AI drafts you approve.
